title: MathIR/v1
description: A mathematical intermediate representation: a typed expression tree over a RESTRICTED OpenMath-style content-dictionary allowlist. The tree is a discriminated union of application nodes ({op, args}), constant nodes ({const: decimal-string}), and variable nodes ({var: symbol-id}). Every application op is a '<cd>.<name>' pair drawn from a fixed allowlist enumerated in $defs/application.properties.op.enum; an op outside that set fails schema validation. The matching Python allowlist lives at srl.semantic.ir.MATH_IR_ALLOWLIST (the single introspectable source of truth) and srl.semantic.ir.validate_expression enforces it again at runtime plus the depth (64) and node-count (10000) resource guards the schema cannot express. Canonical JSON contract: sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, no NaN/Infinity, trailing newline.

ir_id.description: Content-addressed identity of the expression: sha256 over the canonical encoding of the expression (without this field), prefixed 'sha256:'. Computed by srl.semantic.ir.ir_id; a pre-populated value is rejected as a self-hash.

expression.description: The expression tree root. A node is an application ({op, args}), a constant ({const}), or a variable ({var}). Application ops are restricted to the enumerated '<cd>.<name>' allowlist; nums1 symbols (pi, e, i, infinity) are nullary applications ({op: 'nums1.pi', args: []}) and are never carried as float constants.

application.description: An application of an allowlisted operator to zero or more argument expressions. nums1 symbols (pi, e, i, infinity) are nullary applications.

op.description: The operator as '<cd>.<name>'. The value MUST be a member of this enum; any other value (an unknown name in a known cd such as 'arith1.log', or an entirely unknown cd such as 'foo1.plus') fails schema validation. The Python validator (srl.semantic.ir.validate_expression) re-checks the same set.

args.description: Argument expressions. Empty for nullary symbols (nums1.pi, nums1.e, nums1.i, nums1.infinity).

const.description: A decimal-string constant. Non-finite values are never carried here: infinity is the nullary symbol 'nums1.infinity', not a float.
A decimal-string policy value: optional sign, integer digits, optional fractional digits, no exponent.

var.description: A reference to a symbol-id declared in a SymbolTable/v1.
